Quick guide

Zylinderfolgeschach

  1. The files wrap.Lines and piece movement continue across the a/h seam.
  2. Follow when legally possible.The previous move's origin is compulsory if any otherwise legal move can enter it.
  3. King safety comes first.A follower must also resolve check. If none can, any legal check evasion is allowed.
  4. Checkmate still wins.Threefold repetition and 50 moves are automatic draws.
